Here's a comparison of the three iPhone Pro Max models:

## iPhone 15 Pro Max (2023)
- **Chip:** A17 Pro (3nm, 6-core CPU, 6-core GPU with hardware ray tracing)
- **Display:** 6.7" Super Retina XDR, ProMotion 120Hz, Always-On, Dynamic Island, up to 2000 nits
- **Build:** Titanium frame, thinner bezels (~221g)
- **Rear cameras:** 48MP Main, 12MP Ultra Wide, 12MP 5x Telephoto (tetraprism, 120mm)
- **Front:** 12MP TrueDepth
- **Port:** USB-C (USB 3, up to 10 Gbps)
- **Storage:** 256GB / 512GB / 1TB
- **Action button** replaces the mute switch
- **Connectivity:** Wi-Fi 6E, Thread, Emergency SOS via satellite, Roadside Assistance

## iPhone 14 Pro Max (2022)
- **Chip:** A16 Bionic (4nm, 6-core CPU, 5-core GPU)
- **Display:** 6.7" Super Retina XDR, ProMotion 120Hz, Always-On (introduced), Dynamic Island (introduced), up to 2000 nits
- **Build:** Stainless steel frame (~240g)
- **Rear cameras:** 48MP Main (introduced), 12MP Ultra Wide, 12MP 3x Telephoto (77mm)
- **Front:** 12MP TrueDepth (autofocus introduced)
- **Port:** Lightning (USB 2)
- **Storage:** 128GB / 256GB / 512GB / 1TB
- **Mute switch** (no Action button)
- **Connectivity:** Wi-Fi 6, Emergency SOS via satellite (introduced), Crash Detection (introduced)

## iPhone 13 Pro Max (2021)
- **Chip:** A15 Bionic (5nm, 6-core CPU, 5-core GPU)
- **Display:** 6.7" Super Retina XDR, ProMotion 120Hz (introduced), notch design, up to 1200 nits HDR
- **Build:** Stainless steel frame (~240g)
- **Rear cameras:** 12MP Main, 12MP Ultra Wide (macro introduced), 12MP 3x Telephoto
- **Front:** 12MP TrueDepth (no autofocus)
- **Port:** Lightning (USB 2)
- **Storage:** 128GB / 256GB / 512GB / 1TB
- **Mute switch**
- **Connectivity:** Wi-Fi 6, no satellite features

## Key upgrades across generations
| Feature | 13 Pro Max → 14 Pro Max | 14 Pro Max → 15 Pro Max |
|---|---|---|
| Display | + Always-On, Dynamic Island, 2000 nits | (same panel, thinner bezels) |
| Camera | 12MP → 48MP main | 3x → 5x telephoto |
| Build | — | Stainless steel → Titanium (lighter) |
| Port | — | Lightning → USB-C |
| Controls | — | Mute switch → Action button |
| Chip | A15 → A16 | A16 → A17 Pro (ray tracing) |
| Satellite | — | + Emergency SOS | (added Roadside Assistance) |

**Bottom line:** The 15 Pro Max is the biggest leap (titanium, USB-C, 5x zoom, Action button, A17 Pro). The 14 Pro Max's standout was the Dynamic Island and 48MP camera. The 13 Pro Max introduced ProMotion and macro photography to the lineup.
